description.p: Nuclear finds and plays music from many sources in one place. Search for any song, album, or artist, build playlists, and start listening, with no ads and no tracking.

Plugins add new music sources, lyrics, and metadata providers, and themes change how the player looks. Nuclear also shows synced lyrics, keeps your favorites and listening history, and can be controlled remotely from your phone.

ul.li: Security updates for TLS certificate validation (distrusted eMudhra certificates), the auto-updater and the MCP server.
Nuclear now verifies the plugins installed from the store to ensure they're safe to install.
YouTube videos whose IDs start with a dash play again instead of being skipped for the next search result
You can now reorder your playlists manually.
The first YouTube track no longer fails while yt-dlp is still downloading. Playback waits for the download, and a toast shows its progress
Fixed silent YouTube playback on Linux. The AppImage now bundles the GStreamer libav plugin, and the AUR, .deb, and .rpm packages require it.
Listening history no longer records a track twice when the previous track ends on its own
Nuclear Jam shows lyrics now. Tap the microphone button to open the lyrics page

Nuclear can now display lyrics. Install a lyrics plugin to see plain, line-synced, or word-synced lyrics for the current track, with furigana, translations, and romanization. Lyrics are also available through the MCP server and the HTTP API.
rmpc can now connect to Nuclear's MPD server
Fixed the Flatpak build, which broke with newer pnpm versions.
Stream verification is back. Now with offline verification
Fix lag when switching themes.
Stops log spam if Discord Rich Presence is unavailable. Reconnects correctly if it becomes available after Nuclear is launched.
Loading spinners are replaced with skeletons.
The settings dialog is larger, and its sidebar highlights the section you're scrolling through.
Fixed several color issues in themes, buttons, and playlist headers.
Fixed another Flatpak build failure when installing dependencies offline.
Fixed the Flatpak build failing to install dependencies offline.
Updated the Flatpak build for pnpm 12.
Theming system v2: themes can now use gradients on surfaces, and a whole new group of variables to make Nuclear more customizable. See the docs and release notes for details.
Fixed pressing Enter in the search box searching for a hovered recent search instead of the typed text.
Clickable artist/track title in the player bar
Fixed various Appimage issues caused by Wayland.
Plugins that use yt-dlp can now request streams by URL, and get the album, artists, and upload date of each stream.
Streams without a thumbnail show a new placeholder in the stream sources popover.
Fixed playback stopping after double clicking a track in the queue.
Fixed duplicate entries appearing in the listening history.
Fixed the previous track briefly playing when starting a new track before its stream is ready.
Nuclear starts maximized by default
Added Japanese, Polish, and Simplified Chinese to the language list, and finished the Russian and Spanish translations.
Fixed playback stalling every ten seconds (at 0:09, 0:19, and so on) on some tracks, and fixed tracks sometimes not starting after switching to another track.
Fix the queue getting stuck at the end of some tracks, where playback parked a fraction of a second before the end and never advanced to the next track
Right-click a queue item to see its stream candidates and switch to a different source; picking a failed source retries it
Fix TSX plugins failing with 'React is not defined' unless they imported React manually, and fix stale plugin code being served when an imported file changed but the entry file didn't
Fixed the layout and scrolling of track lists in album and playlist views.
The window now remembers its size, position, and maximized state between restarts
